title: which smoke legs compare a published face value at a tolerance finer than the face prints, and do the faces say what precision they print at?
decision_rule: at-risk = the site's tolerance is finer than half the coarsest quantum the face prints; published as a question, never as broken. A measured pair is reported only where the smaller leaf is exactly the larger rounded to d and the gap alone exceeds the tolerance.
no_bill: measurement only: the leg list and the comparison sites are read out of smoke_test.py's source, and every quantum is measured from the published JSON under results/. No study is re-run, no face is rebuilt, no engine runs, no draw stream is regenerated. A site is called AT-RISK, never broken: the face may also publish the full-precision copy the leg actually reads.

summary.cross_face_disclosure: the same key name in two faces is not evidence of the same quantity; the gap is published as a distance so a reader can tell a copy pair from two unrelated studies that happen to share a name. A gap above the tolerance is read as 'same name, different quantity', never as a defect count.
summary.statement: 42 leg(s) carry a numeric comparison against a published face; 29 of them compare at a tolerance finer than the quantum the field they read is printed with (21 of those on the field's own measured decimals, 8 only on the face's coarsest bound). Of 42 face(s) read, 37 publish no precision declaration. 5 site(s) read one key name in two faces; those gaps are published as distances, not as defects.
